newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures slip on long liquidation.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures slip on long liquidation.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended lower on Wednesday, as an easing in markets in rubber-producing countries and the yen's firmer tendency against the dollar spurred long liquidation by individual investors, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.1 yen to 1.4 yen per kg lower. The benchmark June contract was off 1.4 yen at 145.4 yen.
Scattered bargain hunting stemmed further losses.
"Bearish sentiment has continued since the start of this year. The market is looking for a floor with sentiment now favouring a technical correction," one trader said.
